NOVELTY STATEMENT  
Standard practice delivers a MONITORING/INDICATION scheme via pressure differential across the baghouse.  
Novelty: A geometry-based configuration using flow rate and pressure to calculate stickiness index via modified Stokes' law, predicting blinding before pressure rise.  
Physics connection: Sticky fines increase drag coefficient in flow, altering the pressure-flow relationship detectably at sub-critical blinding stages.  

PHYSICS CHECK  
Governing relation: Stickiness Index (SI) = (ΔP / Q) × (μ / ρ) × (d² / L), where ΔP is pressure drop, Q is flow rate, μ is gas viscosity, ρ is gas density, d is particle diameter, L is bag length.  
Magnitude verification: For typical asphalt plant conditions (μ≈1.8e-5 Pa·s, ρ≈1.2 kg/m³, d≈10μm, L≈2m), SI=1e-6 indicates early stickiness; SI=1e-5 predicts imminent blinding.  
CALCULATED: SI threshold derived from stated blinding failure physics (mechanical clogging via sticky fines).
